name: c2patool
role: CLI for inspecting and adding C2PA manifests to media assets
summary: Standalone CLI for inspecting C2PA manifests and adding signed Content Credentials to supported image, audio and video files. JSON reports expose manifest assertions for review; signature and trust checks do not establish that assertions are factually true or provenance is complete.
use_when: Inspect or create C2PA manifests on supported media files
Produce machine-readable reports of signed provenance assertions
Add a credentials step to a separately designed asset handoff
avoid_when: Need ordinary container and codec metadata: use ffprobe or MediaInfo
Need to prove an assertion is true or provenance is complete: C2PA cannot establish that
Need byte-reproducible signed output: signing and timestamps change file bytes
license: Apache-2.0 OR MIT (project code). Certificates, trust lists and signer policy are separate operational requirements.
notes: 2026-11-15: listed-in-prd is a legacy schema status for surfaced candidates; it does not mean this tool appeared in the PRD.
2026-11-15: Current upstream CLI is contentauth/c2patool; the original discovery URL contentauth/c2pa-rs is stale for the standalone CLI.
2026-11-15: C2PA signatures establish integrity and association under configured trust lists, not truth of assertions or completeness of provenance.
2026-11-15: Signed output and embedded timestamps are not byte-reproducible. Supported container/codec combinations need checking against VCR delivery formats.
2026-11-15: A future provenance-specific capability may be useful; not added because it is absent from the current capability vocabulary.
2026-11-15: Skill opportunity: further research first; no VCR asset-manifest workflow or fixture exists yet.

assessment.rationale: Active standalone CLI with current macOS binaries and dual permissive licensing; it provides scriptable C2PA reports and manifest creation for supported media. Integrity and trust checks do not establish the truth of assertions or complete provenance.
